captions.detailed: This 3D model is a modular, stackable container segment with a rounded triangular outer profile. It features an open top cavity with internal twist-lock bayonet grooves and a corresponding bottom lip with male bayonet tabs. The top edge of the outer wall has a smooth, wavy contour that transitions between three rounded corners, while the interior remains circular.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric, stackable container segment in OpenSCAD with a rounded polygonal exterior and a circular interior. The design must include configurable parameters for the interior diameter, wall thickness, segment height, and a bayonet twist-lock mechanism on the top and bottom interfaces so multiple segments can lock together.
captions.factory: The code defines a modular stackable part using a `makePart` module. It uses a custom `polyCylinder` module (constructed with a `hull` of rotated cylinders) to form the outer rounded-triangular body, which is joined with a circular lip cylinder. A `difference` operation cuts out the circular interior cavity and subtracts angled overhangs using `rotate_extrude` and `polygon`. The twist-lock bayonet tabs and matching internal grooves are generated using a helper `thread` module that places curved arc segments at 120-degree intervals.
